stable_user_preferences: Use plain Chinese explanations and concrete steps.
Do not rush into implementation before confirming product direction.
The user wants to manage the game, not manually manage Agents or Sessions.
Preserve the existing AGENTS.md, docs, memory-bank, state and prompt management approach.

confirmed_product_decisions: AI Game Studio is an AI game R&D advisor and automation platform.
DSH is the single AI runtime; Studio owns deterministic business workflows and controls.
Support idea discussion, formal R&D and change request workspaces separately.
Global shared asset library plus project-specific asset library.
Support project import and global Inbox import.
Analyze change impact and obtain approval before updating the baseline.
Exclude post-release monitoring, operation analytics, post-release advisor and iteration.
verified_technical_facts: DSH Runtime is a Node program; the official TypeScript SDK (@deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-client) spawns `dsh --profile sdk` as a child process over stdio JSON-RPC.
The SDK wire protocol exposes only initialize, session/prompt and shutdown. There is NO cancel, NO session/resume and NO session/close method (verified: -32603 'unknown ... method').
Reusing a sessionId that already exists on disk is rejected with 'session "..." already exists', so session continuity cannot rely on DSH.
There is no server->client request, therefore no DSH tool-approval callback exists in 0.1.5. DSH tool permission and Studio business approval must stay two separate mechanisms.
The only sanctioned tool bridge is MCP via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client; tools appear as mcp__<serverName>__<tool>. A launcher --patch file must wrap new rows in `insert:`.
Runtime exit codes observed: 0 for a clean stdin-EOF shutdown, 1 for a failed profile boot.

A crashed profile boot leaves $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules.lock; dsh-atomic-write never checks whether the recorded pid is alive and fails after a 2000 ms deadline, which the SDK surfaces only as 'JSON-RPC input closed'.

Startup is either ~2.5 s (warm) or 73-128 s when the profile module fallback must be rebuilt (187 entries / 164 symlinks on this machine). The SDK default initializeTimeoutMs of 10 s is therefore unusable.

The @deepseek-ai dependency graph is only installable with the whole cordis plugin family pinned to exact versions; caret ranges produce an unsolvable ERESOLVE, and --legacy-peer-deps yields a broken tree.
Session logs are zstd-compressed documents at $DSH_HOME/sessions/<escaped-workspace>/<sessionId>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd (append-only frames).
DeepSeek account balance was insufficient (HTTP 402 QUOTA) during PHASE 00, blocking all model-output assertions.
